list_skills_metadata: list available skills with name, description, and category metadata using skills_list
view_skill_content: view the full content of a skill by name using skill_view with progressive disclosure
view_skill_reference_file: view a specific reference or template file within a skill directory using skill_view with file_path
filter_skills_by_category: filter the skills list to only show skills belonging to a specific category
check_skills_requirements: check whether the skills system is available and ready for use
